name: Pinpoint
description: Pinpoint applicant tracking (ATS): jobs, job postings, hiring workflows and stages, applications, candidates, interviews, comments, scorecards, requisitions, users and company structure. JSON:API v1 on your company's pinpointhq.com subdomain, X-API-KEY header.
instructions:
**Credentials**: Pinpoint needs two values.
1. `PINPOINT_SUBDOMAIN`: the part before `.pinpointhq.com` in the address you sign in at (for `acme.pinpointhq.com` it is `acme`). Each company has its own API host, `https://<subdomain>.pinpointhq.com/api/v1`.
2. `PINPOINT_API_KEY`: in Pinpoint open **Settings > API & Webhooks**, make sure the **Pinpoint API** toggle is on, then create a key on the **API Keys** tab. Pinpoint recommends a separate **read-only** key for AI tools; the two write tools here (`pinpoint_add_comment`, `pinpoint_move_application_stage`) need a key with write access. The key is sent in the `X-API-KEY` header.

A missing or wrong key answers 401; 403 means the API integration is switched off for the account.

**Data model**: a *job* has *job postings* (adverts) and a *hiring workflow* of *stages*. A *candidate* (a person) has one *application* per job; the application sits in a stage. *Comments* are internal notes on applications, candidates or jobs; *interviews* belong to applications. Start with `pinpoint_list_jobs` (status `open`), then `pinpoint_list_applications` with `job_id`, and `pinpoint_get_application` with `include=candidate,stage` for the details.

**JSON:API**: answers follow the JSON:API format: records are in `data[]` with `id`, `type` and `attributes`; related records requested with `include` are in `included[]`, linked through `relationships`. Ids are strings.

**Paging**: `page` starts at 1, `page_size` defaults to 100 (max 1000). Every list asks for `meta.stats.total.count` so you know the total; follow `links.next` or raise `page` until a page has fewer rows than `page_size`.

**Filters**: dates are ISO 8601 (`2026-09-01T00:00:00Z`). Multiple values in one filter are comma-separated (`status=open,hold`). Confidential jobs are hidden from `pinpoint_list_jobs` unless `visibility` names `confidential`.

**Rate limits**: 120 requests per IP per minute and 240 per 8 minutes; above that Pinpoint answers 429 with `Retry-After`. Prefer one list call with filters and `include` over many single fetches.
prerequisites: An administrator has to switch on the **Pinpoint API** under Settings > API & Webhooks before a key can be created.

PINPOINT_SUBDOMAIN.label: Pinpoint subdomain
PINPOINT_SUBDOMAIN.help: The part before .pinpointhq.com in the address you sign in at: for acme.pinpointhq.com enter acme.
PINPOINT_SUBDOMAIN.patternMessage: Only the subdomain, e.g. acme, without https:// or .pinpointhq.com.

PINPOINT_API_KEY.label: API key
PINPOINT_API_KEY.help: Pinpoint > Settings > API & Webhooks > API Keys. Switch on the Pinpoint API toggle first. A read-only key is enough for every read tool.

verifyHints.401: Pinpoint refused the API key. Create a new key under Settings > API & Webhooks > API Keys and check it belongs to this subdomain.
verifyHints.403: The Pinpoint API is switched off for this account. Turn on the Pinpoint API toggle under Settings > API & Webhooks.
verifyHints.404: No Pinpoint API at this subdomain. Enter only the part before .pinpointhq.com.
verifyHints.unreachable: Pinpoint could not be reached at this subdomain. Enter only the part before .pinpointhq.com, e.g. acme.

tools.name: pinpoint_list_jobs
tools.description: List jobs (vacancies) with title, status, visibility, employment type, workplace type and dates. Filter by status, department, location or a search term; add include=stages for the hiring stages.

status.description: Job status, comma-separated: open, closed, archived, pending_approval, draft, hold, cancelled, filled, preview.

visibility.description: Comma-separated: internal, external, confidential, private_job. Confidential jobs are left out unless named here.

department_id.description: Only jobs of this department id (pinpoint_list_departments).

location_id.description: Only jobs of this location id (pinpoint_list_locations).

hiring_manager_user_id.description: Only jobs whose hiring manager is this user id (pinpoint_list_users).

include.description: Comma-separated related resources to embed (JSON:API include): department, division, location, company, hiring_manager_user, recruitment_manager_user, creator_user, job_postings, questions, custom_attributes, stages, applications.

updated_after.description: Only records updated after this time, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z.

created_after.description: Only records created after this time, ISO 8601.

sort.description: Sort key; prefix with - for descending. One of: id, created_at, updated_at, opened_at.

page_size.description: Records per page, default 100, at most 1000. Use small pages (10 to 50) for a first look.

tools.name: pinpoint_get_job
tools.description: Return one job by id with its attributes; use include to embed the hiring stages, job postings, questions, managers, department and location.

include.description: Comma-separated related resources to embed (JSON:API include): department, division, location, company, hiring_manager_user, recruitment_manager_user, creator_user, job_postings, questions, custom_attributes, stages, applications.

tools.name: pinpoint_list_applications
tools.description: List applications (a candidate applying to a job) with stage, status dates, source and contact details. Filter by job, stage, stage type (applied, review, interview, offer, hired, rejected), candidate or e-mail.

job_id.description: Only applications to this job id.

stage_id.description: Only applications currently in this stage id (stages come from pinpoint_get_job or pinpoint_list_hiring_workflows with include=stages).

stage_basic_type.description: Comma-separated stage types: applied, review, interview, offer, hired, rejected.

candidate_id.description: Only applications of this candidate id.

candidate_email.description: Only applications whose candidate has this e-mail address.

include.description: Comma-separated related resources to embed (JSON:API include): job, job_posting, stage, furthest_stage, candidate, offers, answers, custom_attributes, scorecard_ratings, scorecard_notes, user_scorecards, comments, resume, onboarding_application, document_requests.

updated_after.description: Only records updated after this time, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z.

created_after.description: Only records created after this time, ISO 8601.

sort.description: Sort key; prefix with - for descending. One of: id, created_at, updated_at.

page_size.description: Records per page, default 100, at most 1000. Use small pages (10 to 50) for a first look.

tools.name: pinpoint_get_application
tools.description: Return one application by id; include=stage,candidate,job,answers,offers,comments embeds the current stage, the candidate, the job, screening answers, offers and comments.

include.description: Comma-separated related resources to embed (JSON:API include): job, job_posting, stage, furthest_stage, candidate, offers, answers, custom_attributes, scorecard_ratings, scorecard_notes, user_scorecards, comments, resume, onboarding_application, document_requests.

tools.name: pinpoint_list_candidates
tools.description: List candidates (people, across all their applications) with name, e-mail, phone and timestamps. Use updated_after for recent changes, or include=applications to see where each applied.

phone.description: Only candidates with this phone number.

blocked.description: true for blocked candidates only, false to exclude them.

include.description: Comma-separated related resources to embed (JSON:API include): applications, job_seekers, skills, custom_attributes, hris_references.

updated_after.description: Only records updated after this time, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z.

created_after.description: Only records created after this time, ISO 8601.

sort.description: Sort key; prefix with - for descending. One of: id, created_at, updated_at.

page_size.description: Records per page, default 100, at most 1000. Use small pages (10 to 50) for a first look.

tools.name: pinpoint_get_candidate
tools.description: Return one candidate by id with contact details; include=applications lists every application of this person.

id.description: Candidate id from pinpoint_list_candidates or an application's candidate relationship.

include.description: Comma-separated related resources to embed (JSON:API include): applications, job_seekers, skills, custom_attributes, hris_references.

tools.name: pinpoint_list_comments
tools.description: List comments (internal notes) with text, author and date. Filter by what they are attached to, e.g. commentable_type Application with the application id.

commentable_type.description: Type the comments belong to: Application, Candidate, JobSeeker, Job, Task, ReferenceCheckSubmission or PinpointCheckOrder.

commentable_id.description: Id of the record the comments belong to; use together with commentable_type.

include.description: Comma-separated related resources to embed (JSON:API include): user, commentable.

updated_after.description: Only records updated after this time, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z.

created_after.description: Only records created after this time, ISO 8601.

sort.description: Sort key; prefix with - for descending. One of: id, created_at, updated_at.

page_size.description: Records per page, default 100, at most 1000. Use small pages (10 to 50) for a first look.

tools.name: pinpoint_list_interviews
tools.description: List scheduled interviews with start and end time, attendance (attended, no_show) and the stage. Filter by start time window or by the application interviewed.

start_after.description: Only interviews starting after this time, ISO 8601.

start_before.description: Only interviews starting before this time, ISO 8601.

interviewable_type.description: Type of record interviewed, usually Application.

interviewable_id.description: Id of that record, e.g. an application id.

include.description: Comma-separated related resources to embed (JSON:API include): stage, interview_parts, interviewable.

sort.description: Sort key; prefix with - for descending. One of: id, created_at, updated_at, start_at.

page_size.description: Records per page, default 100, at most 1000. Use small pages (10 to 50) for a first look.

tools.name: pinpoint_get_interview
tools.description: Return one interview by id with its times, attendance and, with include, the stage, the interview parts and the application interviewed.

include.description: Comma-separated related resources to embed (JSON:API include): stage, interview_parts, interviewable.

tools.name: pinpoint_list_hiring_workflows
tools.description: List hiring workflows (the stage pipelines jobs use). include defaults to stages, so each workflow comes with its ordered stages and their ids for filtering applications.

include.description: Related resources to embed; "stages" (default) adds the workflow's stages.

sort.description: Sort key; prefix with - for descending. One of: id, created_at, updated_at.

page_size.description: Records per page, default 100, at most 1000. Use small pages (10 to 50) for a first look.

tools.name: pinpoint_list_job_postings
tools.description: List job postings (the adverts of a job on the careers site and job boards) with title, status, employment and workplace type. Filter by job, status or location.

job_id.description: Only postings of this job id.

location_id.description: Only postings for this location id.

include.description: Comma-separated related resources to embed, e.g. job.

sort.description: Sort key; prefix with - for descending. One of: id, created_at, updated_at.

page_size.description: Records per page, default 100, at most 1000. Use small pages (10 to 50) for a first look.

tools.name: pinpoint_list_departments
tools.description: List the company's departments with id and name. Use the id to filter jobs and job postings by department.

updated_after.description: Only records updated after this time, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z.

created_after.description: Only records created after this time, ISO 8601.

sort.description: Sort key; prefix with - for descending. One of: id, created_at, updated_at.

page_size.description: Records per page, default 100, at most 1000. Use small pages (10 to 50) for a first look.

tools.name: pinpoint_list_divisions
tools.description: List the company's divisions with id and name, the level above departments in Pinpoint's company structure.

updated_after.description: Only records updated after this time, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z.

created_after.description: Only records created after this time, ISO 8601.

sort.description: Sort key; prefix with - for descending. One of: id, created_at, updated_at.

page_size.description: Records per page, default 100, at most 1000. Use small pages (10 to 50) for a first look.

tools.name: pinpoint_list_locations
tools.description: List the company's locations with id, name and address. Use the id to filter jobs and job postings by location.

sort.description: Sort key; prefix with - for descending. One of: id, created_at, updated_at.

page_size.description: Records per page, default 100, at most 1000. Use small pages (10 to 50) for a first look.

tools.name: pinpoint_list_users
tools.description: List Pinpoint users (recruiters, hiring managers, interviewers) with name, e-mail and role. Filter by e-mail or by the job they manage; the id is used for comment authors.

email.description: Only the user with this e-mail address.

hiring_manager_job_id.description: Only the hiring managers of this job id.

sort.description: Sort key; prefix with - for descending. One of: id, created_at, updated_at.

page_size.description: Records per page, default 100, at most 1000. Use small pages (10 to 50) for a first look.

tools.name: pinpoint_list_scorecards
tools.description: List the interview scorecard templates with their sections and the stages they apply to (use include). Filled-in ratings are on the application, via include=user_scorecards.

include.description: Comma-separated related resources to embed (JSON:API include): scorecard_sections, scorecard_notes, user_scorecards, stages.

sort.description: Sort key; prefix with - for descending. One of: id, created_at, updated_at.

page_size.description: Records per page, default 100, at most 1000. Use small pages (10 to 50) for a first look.

tools.name: pinpoint_list_requisitions
tools.description: List job requisitions (approved requests to hire) with identifier, status and dates. Jobs can be filtered by requisition id in pinpoint_list_jobs.

identifier.description: Only the requisition with this identifier.

sort.description: Sort key; prefix with - for descending. One of: id, created_at, updated_at.

page_size.description: Records per page, default 100, at most 1000. Use small pages (10 to 50) for a first look.

tools.name: pinpoint_add_comment
tools.description: Add an internal comment (note) to an application, a candidate or a job seeker. The note is visible to the hiring team in Pinpoint, not to the candidate.

commentable_type.description: What the comment is attached to.

commentable_id.description: Id of that application, candidate or job seeker.

tools.name: pinpoint_move_application_stage
tools.description: Move an application to another stage of its hiring workflow, e.g. from review to interview. Stage moves can trigger the automatic e-mails configured on that stage.

stage_id.description: Target stage id from the job's stages (pinpoint_get_job with include=stages).
